text:
Kai N: quick one from support  export snapshots failing for big models -> error toast says 'Export failed'. users confused whether artifacts exist. sketch: https://redwood.design/export-error-sketch :paperclip:
Fiona G: agree, 'Export failed' is too vague. two copy directions:
  1) short + actionable: `Export failed. Try again with smaller model or contact support.`
  2) explicit + diagnostic: `Export failed: insufficient disk space on export node. Try a smaller model or change destination.`
Marco L: we should avoid leaking infra details in UI unless it's helpful. maybe: `Export failed due to resource limits. Try reducing model size or export fewer files.` keeps it user-facing and actionable.
Kai N: good point. Also need a secondary inline help link in the toast: `(Learn how to export large models)` that points to docs.
Fiona G: toast CTA candidates:
  - primary: `Retry export` (quick)
  - primary: `Export with reduced assets` (explicit but long)
Marco L: `Retry export` is fine; when clicked open a small modal with advanced options (checkboxes: `Exclude embeddings`, `Exclude logs`, `Split export into chunks`). modal microcopy should explain each option briefly.
Kai N: modal heading: `Retry export with reduced assets` body line for each toggle. sample toggle label + helper: `Exclude embeddings — Omits generated embeddings, reduces size.` keep sentence-case.
Fiona G: accessibility notes: toast should be `role=alert` with `aria-live=assertive` for failures; CTA buttons need descriptive `aria-label`s like `Retry export for model X with reduced assets` and the modal fields must be reachable and have `aria-describedby` for helpers.
Marco L: also recommend we add a short error subtitle in toast: `Some artifacts may have been created. Check the Exports page.` helps users know where to look.
Kai N: final toast proposal:
  - body: `Export failed due to resource limits. Some artifacts may have been created. Check the Exports page.`
  - primary CTA: `Retry export` (opens modal with options)
  - docs link: `Learn how to export large models`
  - aria pattern: `role=alert` + `aria-live=\"assertive\"` + CTA aria-label `Retry export for <model name>`
Fiona G: modal microcopy quick draft:
  - heading: `Retry export for <model name>`
  - body: `Choose options to reduce export size. You can try a smaller asset selection or split the export into multiple parts.`
  - toggles:
    * `Exclude embeddings` — `Omits generated embeddings from the export.`
    * `Exclude logs` — `Omits runtime logs and diagnostics.`
    * `Split into chunks` — `Exports in multiple files to avoid single-file limits.`
  - primary CTA: `Start export` (aria-label: `Start export for <model name> with selected options`)
  - secondary: `Cancel`
Marco L: one more tone nit: avoid passive-voice errors like 'Some artifacts may have been created.' maybe: `Some artifacts were created before the failure. Check the Exports page.` clearer.
Fiona G: good catch. also for small screens shorten toast line to `Export failed. Some artifacts may have been created.` with the longer diagnostic on hover/expand.
A11y Bot: checklist: 1) failure toast use `role=alert` and assertive `aria-live` 2) include direct link to Exports page with descriptive link text 3) modal fields have `aria-describedby` for helper text and toggles are keyboard accessible 4) when `Start export` completes, announce success/failure via `aria-live` toast with link to the export artifact 5) ensure focus is trapped in modal and returned to triggering element on close
Kai N: ok I'll update the mock and add exact string examples to the PR. approvals?
Fiona G: approved, add truncated variants for mobile. :white_check_mark:
Marco L: approved. :white_check_mark:
A11y Bot: decision recorded: toast copy = `Export failed due to resource limits. Some artifacts were created before the failure. Check the Exports page.` + primary `Retry export` -> modal `Retry export for <model name>` with toggles and CTAs + accessibility checklist included in component docs. Kai to land the PR.
